answer: An farming party running 33 aliases thus needs 122 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in nadir, expire in basalt, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 513 identities would post 4400 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
